refused.draft_taken: Someone else already has a draft here. Once it is published or discarded, you can carry on.
refused.stale_revision: The draft has changed in the meantime. Reload the page and apply your changes again.
refused.no_draft: There is no draft to publish.
refused.approval_required: This change needs the approval of a second person.
refused.unchanged: The draft equals the live version. There is nothing to publish.
refused.legal_not_draft: This text is already published and can no longer be changed.
refused.legal_version_taken: Version :version already exists for this document. Choose a new one.
refused.legal_pending_approval: Version :version is waiting for approval. Until then the text stays as it is.
refused.legal_changed: The draft was changed after the request. The approval does not cover this text.
refused.template_fixed: This text is fixed and cannot be changed.
refused.release_taken: This build is already in the register (same version, build number, channel and platform).

flash.published: Published. The app picks up the change within 5 minutes.
flash.rolled_back: Rolled back. The earlier version is live now.
flash.releases_unchanged: RELEASES.md read: everything is in the register already.
flash.releases_file_missing: RELEASES.md is not on this server. Enter builds here by hand.

draft.defaults_body: Nothing published yet: the bundled values apply.
draft.foreign: Draft by :name, last saved :date. You can look at it but not edit it.
draft.publish_body: The draft becomes the new live version. Members see it within 5 minutes. You can roll back in the version history at any time.
draft.request_body: This change only goes live once a second person in the team approves it.
draft.discard_body: All saved changes of this draft are lost. Everything live stays as it is.
draft.discard_foreign_body: The draft by :name is deleted. Give the reason, it goes into the audit log.
draft.leave_body: Your changes are not saved yet and will be lost.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.intro: Switches for features. Only the :environment column takes effect here; the other environments have their own databases and show the planned state.
flags.caption: Feature flags
flags.error: The flags could not be loaded.
flags.empty_body: Flags come with the code. They appear here after the next deploy.
flags.ai_note: No AI provider configured: AI flags stay off until a provider with a key is set up (System → Integrations).
flags.this_environment: This environment: takes effect at once
flags.other_environment: Planned state: there the switch in its own database applies
flags.staff_only_hint: Members do not see the feature even when the flag is on; it stays with the team.
flags.percentage_hint: 0 to 100. The choice is fixed per member, it does not change with every start.
flags.critical_hint: Critical flags in production only change with a second approval.
flags.four_eyes: This change in production needs the approval of a second person. Until then the flag stays as it is.

remote.title: Remote config
remote.intro: Minimum and latest app version, the update notice and maintenance mode. You confirm every change with your password.
remote.error: The remote config could not be loaded.
remote.versions_intro: Below the minimum version the app can no longer be used and asks for an update. Below the latest version a notice appears.
remote.latest_release: Latest production build in the release register: :version
remote.no_release: The release register has no production build yet.
remote.force_intro: Shown when the installed version is below the minimum version. Empty: the bundled text applies.
remote.maintenance_intro: Members only see the maintenance notice until you switch the mode off again. Switching it on needs a second person, switching it off works at once.
remote.maintenance_message_hint: What is going on and when does it continue? Required while the mode is on.
remote.maintenance_live: Maintenance mode is on right now. Members cannot use the app.
remote.bypass: The team keeps working during maintenance: through the draft preview, team members see the app as usual. Members have no access.

releases.title: Release register
releases.intro: Every build with version, build number, platform, channel, checksum and notes.
releases.caption: Builds
releases.empty_title: No builds in the register yet
releases.empty_body: Import the builds from RELEASES.md or record one by hand.
releases.empty_body_manual: Record the first build by hand.
releases.version_hint: Three numbers like 1.0.0, optionally with a suffix (1.0.0-rc.1).
releases.code_hint: A whole number, as it is in the build.
releases.sha_hint: 64 characters 0–9 and A–F, as build-apk prints them.
